facts.headline: Amazon's Astro and the Energy Cost of Giving Robots a Soul
facts.summary: Amazon's attempt to give its Astro robot a distinct character exposes the massive physical toll of AI infrastructure energy use. This design choice transforms a simple appliance into an energy-intensive entity that accelerates climate volatility. The move illustrates how consumer tech desires directly compound the upstream drivers of systemic breakdown.
